121. Betrayal (2)
"Damn it, it won't work. Hit me, Dante."
"What are you talking about?"
"It means to hit my jaw until I feel better."
He seemed serious. Veradin stuck out his jaw, and Jin and Dante looked at each other.
"It's because my damn family and the royal family are screwing over Hairan. If I get hit until I feel better, too."
"Speak reasonably, Veradin. If Dante hits you with even a little bit of sincerity, it won't end with just an injury. Can your weak body handle it?"
"Damn it, I know."
"Why are you babbling nonsense if you know?"
"I'm so sorry, and I'm so frustrated that I have to say something... This is just to make myself feel better."
"Just looking at you, getting hit might not be a bad idea."
"I didn't do anything wrong."
At Jin and Dante's words, Veradin sighed.
"I knew you'd say that. Dante, tell me if there's anything I can do to help...! On behalf of my family, I'll apologize in any way I can."
Jin and Dante were not at ease, looking at the flustered Veradin.
If Veradin had any guilt, it was only because he was born into the Zipfel family and was being used by his father.

"There's no need for excessive words like an apology. I called you not to argue, but rather to ask for your help as a friend. The situation in Zipfel must be far from ordinary as well, so I should be the one thanking you for coming."
"Ugh... Dante, you're such a gentleman!"
As Veradin exaggeratedly reddened his eyes and hugged Dante, Jin clicked his tongue.
Anyway, as Dante said, it was a risk for Veradin to visit Gomhwangseong secretly at this time.
Zipfel is still strongly claiming no responsibility for the incident. If Veradin's secret visit were to be exposed, that claim would inevitably lose its strength.
After rubbing some tears, or fake tears, on his shirt, a faint smile appeared on Dante's lips.
It was the first time Jin and Dante had seen each other smile since the incident. That's how bad the situation was in Hairan.
Not only did the royal family make a filthy deal with the terrorist group, but there were also traitors within.
Even worse, the main culprits of the betrayal were Dante's brothers and relatives. They were always treated as 'non-existent' by Ron Hairan.
They never dreamed of betrayal in the first place. Instead of messing with Dante and getting beaten up by Ron, they were pinning their faint hopes on the generation after Dante.
It had been a long time since Ron had completely taken control of Hairan, and Dante was smoothly inheriting that power.
It was as if a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity had come. If it were just a huge loss due to terrorism, they would never have dreamed of betrayal, but the royal family backed them up.
That was still fine. Ron and his Hairan were more than capable of dealing with the rebels and getting back up without anyone's help.

However, the problem was that too many 'non-Highland victims' were created due to the terror. There were more than a few matters to be compensated for, not only for the royal family and numerous nobles, but also for prominent military factions.
'Ron must have anticipated to some extent that the situation would turn out this way. That's why he put me under his protection as a priority.'
Jin had also somewhat anticipated it.
However, there was one story that Jin could not imagine at all.
'The reason why the royal family pushed Highland to the brink by making some kind of deal with Kinzelo and Zipfel.'
It was because they wanted to obtain a certain 'item' that the Highland family had been guarding for generations.
To be precise, it should be described as an item that 'the head of the Highland family' had been guarding.
Only the head of the family could know whether the item even existed in the first place.
However, Ron revealed the existence of the item as soon as he appointed Dante as the head, and Dante recently broke the taboo of passing on the secret only to the head of the Highland family.
He informed Jin of the item's existence.
-...White stones, ominous gravel, wedges pointing to the end, etc. The past heads of the family called the stone by various names.
- The fact that there are so many names means that no one knows the real name of the stone.
- You could think that way. You're right. When my grandfather first told me about the stone, he described it as the greatest nemesis of the Highland family head.
- The greatest nemesis of the Highland family head?

- The purpose of the existence of the stone, which is passed on only from the head to the head, is to cut it. Only the head who finally cuts the stone can engrave his name at the highest point in the history of the Highland family.
- It doesn't seem like the royal family would covet an item that's just all about that.
- You're right.

- I get it roughly. The stone must be a dangerous item that should not be revealed to anyone in the world. So, the first Highland family head who obtained the item tried to cut and destroy it, and failed. After that, the future heads left only the order to destroy the item without revealing its identity so that they wouldn't be greedy.
- You deduced all that just by listening to my short explanation? Shocking.
- The fact that not only all the past heads of the Highland family, but also Ron, could not cut the stone is even more shocking. What kind of stone is it?
- I've never seen it myself. My grandfather is keeping it.
- Anyway, the reason the royal family covets the stone is because they want to get their hands on the danger that the old heads of the Highland family have been keeping in check.
The conversation I had with Dante a few days ago.

The royal family was making a fuss about taking the 'stone' from Highland as if they had been waiting for such an opportunity. It wouldn't be strange even if the royal family had sponsored the terror to get the stone.
The reason Dante told Jin about the stone was because he concluded that it wouldn't be bad to get Jin's help in protecting it.
Of course, it was Dante's opinion, but Ron agreed more readily than expected.

He was seriously injured, the family's status had fallen, traitors had appeared, and the Sword Emperor Castle had not even begun to recover, and there were no allies. The knights had returned to the royal family as well.
In a situation where his precious grandson could be isolated at the slightest slip, Ron was a person who prioritized his grandson's safety over the secrets
More than anything, Jin was confident that he wasn't the type to covet the stone and stab them in the back.
Cheot-eok.
Jin pulled Veradin away from Dante. The way he was flailing around felt like dealing with a child.
"Veradin, sir."
Dante wiped away his laughter and locked eyes with Veradin.
Jin and Dante had decided not to share information about the 'stone' with Veradin yet. It was only natural since they couldn't be sure if Veradin's mind was completely intact.
However, even without that information, there was no problem with helping Jin and Dante.
"Yeah, go ahead and tell me, Dante. What do you want me to do?"
"Have the Zipfel directly pressure Hairan."
"Uh... what?"
"Right now, Zipfel is only indirectly pressuring Hairan through the Royal Palace. Instead, I mean to create a situation where Zipfel takes the forefront and directly attacks Hairan."
"Wh-why? Hey, Jin. What does this mean?"
"Why are you asking me?"
"Dante couldn't have thought of this plan! Explain, why do we have to do this?"
"To more clearly distinguish Hairan's enemies."
"What?"

"It's about figuring out which of Zipfel and Hairan the Royal Palace values more. If the Royal Palace doesn't change its attitude even when you push Hairan to the limit, Hairan no longer needs to be part of the empire."
More precisely, it was a move to check what the Royal Palace considered most important among Zipfel, Hairan, and the 'stone'.
"I get what you're saying, but what if the Royal Palace chooses Zipfel and decides to finish off Hairan with us?"
"You'll have to stop that yourself."
"I'm not the head of Zipfel, but the next head, right? Do I have that kind of authority?"
"I'm kidding, in that case, Runcandel will join Hairan."
"You're also the next head of Runcandel, not the current head."
"I have that much authority. More precisely, I'm confident that I can make my family follow suit after making a move to form an alliance with Hairan."
Veradin's eyes sparkled as if to say that Jin's words and attitude were impressive, then he coughed.
Now was not the time to play around and praise Jin as usual.
"I understand, but aren't there too many variables? And I doubt the Royal Palace would choose Zipfel over Hairan. The whole world is watching."
"We don't know that."
"…If the main house steps in, Hairan might be damaged beyond repair."
"Isn't that underestimating Hairan too much? Especially in front of Dante."
"Hmm, hmm. I'm fine with it."
"Sorry. But it's such an important matter… Besides, if I'm not in a sound state of mind, what if this plan is manipulated to be most advantageous for our family?"
"That would indeed be the worst-case scenario, but we have our own safety measures, so don't worry."
"Oh? Safety measures! What are they?"
"I don't need to tell you that."
At Jin's words, Veradin gave a bitter smile.
"True."
"Veradin, just be careful until your mind is back to normal. We'll be cautious of you too."
Veradin nodded his head.

"Let's figure out the enemy, and take a look at the goals and priorities of the Royal Palace and Zipfel. If possible, let's find out if the Royal Palace has had any backdoor deals with Kinzelo and Zipfel."
Jin, Dante, and Veradin worked on this task behind the scenes.
It was the duty of Ron and his knights to support Hairan by establishing an internal and external center.

"Even if our families become enemies on the surface, it's enough if our alliance among the three of us is solid. Then, when we each have control over our families, we can also restore our external relationships."
"You're right."
"Ohh."
At the moment when the three of them agreed, a knight came looking for them in the basement. He was one of the knights who initially escorted Veradin.
"Vice-head."
"What is it?"
"Well…"
The knight glanced at Veradin and continued.
"His Majesty the Emperor is looking for Jin."
"Jin? Why?"
"I'm not sure, but according to rumors among the court officials… it seems like he wants to bestow a reward for this incident."
